pages.title: AMR-1 "Icarus"
pages.text: ORSA's antimatter reactor. A trickle of antimatter sets off the Halsey Cascade through ordinary matter.

pages.title: History
pages.text: Dr. Helena Halsey's last ORSA project. It was never switched on.$(br2)$(flavor)ORSA's notes call it 'the sun on a leash'.$()

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: $(li)A Halsey Core holds the sphere in a shield$(li)Four stabilizers feed the shield$(li)An injector feeds ordinary matter$(li)Net output 0.6 to 1.7 MW

pages.title: Before You Build
pages.text: $(danger)Breaking any part while the core holds antimatter detonates it instantly.$() An empty reactor is safe to build, change and take down.
